title: KyuBeacons
description: Adds "beacons" which can apply Custom Effects onto nearby Players, such as give them Blindness or force them into Adventure Mode.
body:
Adds various craftable "beacons" which can apply custom effects onto players within their radius (50 blocks by default).

The "beacons" have health and can be disabled by weakness, they can also pick up items (for example you could give them armor or totems as protection). Whatever the tooltips might say, they do NOT directly deal any damage.
### List of currently implemented beacons:

- Visionary Beacon
> Grants nearby players night vision
- Adventure Beacon
> Sets nearby players' gamemode to Adventure Mode
> (sets them back to Survival Mode after being out of its radius for a while)
- Darkness Beacon
> Afflicts nearby players with darkness and blindness


Recipes are shown in the in-game recipe book under the "misc" tab.

Yes, the tooltips are a silly reference to Path of Exile.

I highly reccommend using a mod like [Paxi](https://modrinth.com/mod/paxi) to autoload datapacks from the <modpack>\datapacks\ folder, otherwise you would have to manually add the datapack to the "datapacks" folder rooted in your world files.

Feel free to join my [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/cYa9VNz9zF) for suggestions and bug reports!
